encoding.serverSeed: 32 cryptographically random bytes rendered as 64 lowercase hex characters
encoding.hashedValue: the UTF-8 bytes of that 64-character hex string, NOT the 32 bytes it encodes
encoding.roll: first 8 hex characters of the HMAC -> unsigned integer -> % 10000 -> hundredths (0..9999)
encoding.note: Every runtime that verifies an outcome must use this exact representation. Treating the server seed as 32 binary bytes instead of its 64-character text produces a completely different digest.
